claims.text: The proposed model is compared to many existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
The model is compared to R.M.-Reader + Verifier, which is more complicated and includes several components.
The proposed model is an extension of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN), which is a state-of-the-art model.
The proposed model achieves competitive results compared to SAN on the SQuAD 2.0 dataset.
